description: A `!{}`-guarded multi-statement handler inside a component body (RT). Clicking runs the .Empty arm (@r = 1) and then the second statement (@msg = "y"). Before S440 a component body's handler got no statement list from the native re-parse, so the string lowering emitted a raw `!{` (E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S439 #14 + S440 "all recs" (restore conformance); review:S440-fix-round-F4
rationale: §5.2.3 — an inline block's statements run in order and none is dropped, wherever the handler sits. §19.4.3 — `!{}` handles the failable call.
